name: roundmacrocontroller-v2
description: RoundMacroController V2 - ESP32-S3 Round Display Macro Controller
author: RoundMacroController V2

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2) + '\n');"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && cross-env RMC_ELECTRON_DEV=true electron .
scripts.pack:win:dir: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
